candidates.description: This vector represents computing technology, including software, hardware, and computational models.

This vector is related to common suffixes and morphological endings used in Romance and English word formation.
This vector activates for words and subwords related to automation, machinery, and self-movement.
This vector represents abstract concepts, principles, and strategic thinking related to human knowledge and decision-making.

This vector represents concepts related to linguistics, language processing, and human cognition.
